completed_unit.target: Cargo vendored-source consumption and source-replacement semantics
completed_unit.result: The pinned official cargo-vendor documentation states that cargo vendor materializes all crates.io and git dependencies into the selected vendor directory. After vendoring, Cargo prints the configuration necessary to use those vendored sources, and that configuration must be added or redirected into Cargo configuration (normally .cargo/config.toml) before Cargo consumes the vendor directory. Cargo treats vendored sources as read-only like registry and git sources. The same document states that --offline prevents network access and restricts Cargo to locally downloaded material, while --frozen combines --locked and --offline. Therefore an already-materialized vendor directory is not by itself a complete consumption mechanism: the generated source configuration is also required. This source supports read-only source-consumption semantics but does not establish cryptographic checksum verification or the exact generated source-replacement keys.
